coverage: Fixed independently frozen canonical/signature vector; binds exact method, raw path/query/body bytes, audience, signer, nonce and timestamps; rejects malformed/noncanonical/oversized envelopes, invalid time/signatures, missing/duplicate/unknown/legacy headers, key/replay failures; verifies one-use atomicity for the process-local replay store and rejects that store in live modes.
limits: Synthetic cryptographic keys, fixed clock, in-process TestClient and process-local replay store. No durable cross-process replay, real provider/identity resolver, live HTTP/TLS, parallel workers sharing durable storage, restart/revocation persistence, or testnet readiness established.

independent_review.scope: package checksums, four current source/test hashes, exact captures, listed canonical/auth/replay coverage and limitations
